description: This file contains test cases for loading and validating Vertex AI credentials, as well as performance benchmarking for asynchronous API calls to a modeled endpoint, using pytest and asyncio.

methods.name: load_vertex_ai_credentials()
methods.description: Loads and updates Google Cloud Vertex AI credentials from environment variables and a JSON file, creating a temporary credentials file and setting the environment variable for authentication.

methods.name: test_vertex_load()
methods.description: Asynchronous test function that loads credentials, runs multiple performance tests with different message types, and asserts the performance threshold.

methods.name: make_async_calls(message_type="text")
methods.description: Performs multiple asynchronous API calls with a specified message type, measures total response time.

methods.name: create_async_task(message_type)
methods.description: Creates an asyncio task that calls the litellm.acompletion method with specific message content based on the message type.
